# clawmain agent departments

Use this to recommend agent plugins at the end of `/groundwork` (init). Recommend at most 3 departments, matched to the repo profile and the user's answers. Give each a why-tag.

Install: `/plugin install <slug>@clawmain` (after `/plugin marketplace add vishnu-77/clawmain`).

| Slug | Recommend when | Agents |
|---|---|---|
| `agent-ops` | The user runs long or multi-step agent tasks, chains several agents, or wants agents to stop wasting turns. | loop-planner, loop-verifier, loop-reflector, budget-controller, handoff-router, stop-condition-judge, failure-analyst, memory-curator, skill-extractor, agent-auditor, eval-designer |
| `ai-engineering` | The repo calls an LLM API (Anthropic, OpenAI, or others), builds agents or RAG, or ships prompts as part of the product. | llm-eval-builder, prompt-engineer, rag-reviewer, hallucination-checker, llm-cost-estimator, tool-schema-designer, guardrail-designer, agent-architect, prompt-regression-tester, context-engineer |
| `architecture` | The repo is medium or large, has several modules or packages, is a monorepo, or the user plans a refactor, migration, or new service. | module-mapper, dependency-grapher, boundary-enforcer, refactor-planner, interface-designer, data-model-reviewer, scalability-reviewer, migration-planner, monorepo-organizer, tech-stack-advisor |
| `code-review` | The user reviews PRs, wants a second opinion before merging, or ships changes without a human reviewer. | bug-hunter, api-contract-reviewer, concurrency-reviewer, error-handling-reviewer, performance-reviewer, readability-reviewer, simplifier, dead-code-finder, pr-describer, review-triager |
| `devops` | The repo has CI workflows, Dockerfiles, deploy configs, or regular releases, or the user complains about slow or flaky pipelines. | ci-doctor, build-accelerator, release-notes-writer, versioning-advisor, dockerfile-reviewer, env-config-auditor, deploy-checklist-runner, observability-planner, incident-responder, infra-cost-reviewer |
| `docs` | The repo has thin or outdated docs, new contributors struggle to start, or the user ships a library or API others consume. | readme-writer, api-doc-writer, onboarding-guide-writer, changelog-keeper, docstring-writer, glossary-builder, tutorial-writer, doc-drift-detector, diagram-maker, faq-builder |
| `explainable-ai` | Humans review or approve agent-made changes, the team needs audit trails, or the product ships AI features that must be explained to users or regulators. | decision-explainer, change-narrator, evidence-linker, assumption-surfacer, confidence-calibrator, trace-reporter, alternatives-recorder, adr-writer, model-card-writer, reviewer-briefer |
| `quality` | The repo has tests (or should), CI is flaky, coverage is unclear, or changes keep breaking things that tests missed. | test-gap-finder, flaky-test-hunter, regression-test-writer, property-test-designer, mutation-test-advisor, coverage-analyst, e2e-scenario-planner, fixture-builder, snapshot-reviewer, contract-test-writer |
| `risk-reward` | The repo ships to production users, handles data or money, has frequent releases, or the user wants a clear go/no-go before merging. | change-risk-scorer, blast-radius-mapper, rollback-planner, dependency-risk-auditor, migration-risk-reviewer, feature-flag-planner, cost-benefit-analyst, premortem-facilitator, release-gatekeeper, tech-debt-ledger |
| `safety` | Agents run commands or edit code with broad permissions, the repo handles credentials or personal data, or the product includes LLM features exposed to users. | secrets-scanner, destructive-command-guard, permission-minimizer, prompt-injection-reviewer, pii-detector, license-checker, supply-chain-auditor, sandbox-advisor, data-deletion-guard, llm-output-safety-reviewer |
| `token-economy` | The repo is large, sessions hit context limits or compaction often, CI logs or diffs are huge, or the user cares about agent cost. | context-budgeter, prompt-compressor, cache-planner, diff-summarizer, log-trimmer, model-router, retrieval-scoper, output-shaper, session-summarizer, tool-call-auditor |
